title: DARPA special access program to reverse-engineer cephalopod camouflage
summary: John Blitch tells of DARPA special access program to reverse-engineer cephalopod camouflage, about 2000 at DARPA, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: mindblowing oh well my my special Access program um was trying to reverse engineer uh camouflage from spilop pods

plain: John Blitch, a former scientist at DARPA, the US military's advanced research agency, says that around 2000 he ran a special access programme, meaning a tightly restricted secret project. He told podcast host Jesse Michels that it tried to copy the camouflage of cephalopods, sea animals like octopus and squid, working with scientists including Roger Hanlon.
